name: D. Kalacheva
evidence: Full name resolved to Daria Kalacheva, co-author of 'Cultural Evaluation of LLMs in Russian: Catchphrases and Cultural Types' (Dialogue 2025, https://dialogue-conf.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/GromenkoEetal.029.pdf). That PDF is the only likely place her address is printed and dialogue-conf.org is egress-blocked here (curl -> CONNECT 403); a WebSearch over the paper's author list surfaced no email. GitHub code search for '"Kalacheva" "@" in:file' returned only unrelated namesakes (Alina Kalacheva at cylind.com, Daria Kalacheva at culture.ru, Vera Kalacheva verkalacheva@mail.ru in an ITMO repo, Alisa Kalacheva) with no link to Russian NLP / cultural LLM evaluation, so the namesake rule blocks all of them.
